display.purpose: A thing's name on its page; big wear counts.

title.purpose: Section heads, sheet titles, place names.

label.purpose: Button and link text; never wraps.

caption.purpose: Spaced-capital section captions only; the floor size.

itemColour.page: itemColour(): lift HSL lightness under 16% to 16% (saturation cap 50%), then darken in 1% steps until chalk #F4F1EB reads at 4.5:1.
itemColour.tint: tintOf(): page hue at 88% lightness, saturation cap 45%, raised until 4.5:1 on the page colour.

shadows.name: focus-ring
shadows.purpose: Every focus-visible element; fields use an inset 2px chalk ring.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Default easing for rises, presses, pops, grows.

motion.name: ease-flood
motion.purpose: Colour fills: the flood, wish and bought fills.

motion.name: flood
motion.value: 550ms open / 450ms back, clip-path circle via View Transitions
motion.purpose: Opening a thing grows its colour from the tap point; old page dims to 45%.

motion.name: bands-grow
motion.value: 600ms scaleY, 70ms per band; pieces drop 450ms after 250ms

motion.name: bar-grow
motion.purpose: Numbers bars and the fit bar.

motion.name: fill-up
motion.purpose: Wish tile filling; a bought wish.

motion.name: pop
motion.purpose: Selection ticks, camera thumbnails, fix points.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Chalk with ink text; the one primary action in a view.
components.css: .ds-acc { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; min-height:48px; padding:0 16px; border:0; border-radius:14px; background:#F4F1EB; color:#16130F; font:700 16px/1.2 'Atkinson Hyperlegible', Verdana, sans-serif; white-space:nowrap; transition:transform .15s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-acc:hover { opacity:.92; } .ds-acc:active { transform:scale(.97); } .ds-acc:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #F4F1EB; outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary action: a 2px outline in white at 33%.
components.css: .ds-ghost { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; min-height:48px; padding:0 16px; border:2px solid #FFFFFF54; border-radius:14px; background:transparent; color:#F4F1EB; font:700 16px/1.2 'Atkinson Hyperlegible', Verdana, sans-serif; white-space:nowrap; transition:transform .15s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), border-color .2s; } .ds-ghost:hover { border-color:#FFFFFF80; } .ds-ghost:active { transform:scale(.97); } .ds-ghost:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #F4F1EB; outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Kind Chip
components.description: Filter pill with a kind dot and count; fills chalk when on.
components.css: .ds-chips { display:flex; gap:8px; padding:12px; background:#101114; } .ds-chip { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:7px; min-height:44px; padding:0 14px; border-radius:22px; border:2px solid #FFFFFF54; background:transparent; color:#F4F1EB; font:400 15px/1.2 'Atkinson Hyperlegible', Verdana, sans-serif; white-space:nowrap; transition:background .2s, color .2s, border-color .2s; } .ds-chip:hover { border-color:#FFFFFF80; } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #F4F1EB; outline-offset:2px; } .ds-chip.ds-on { background:#F4F1EB; border-color:#F4F1EB; color:#16130F; font-weight:700; } .ds-dot { width:14px; height:14px; border-radius:50%; box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px #FFFFFF44; } .ds-chip:not(.ds-on) .ds-n { color:#BDB8B0; }

components.name: Field
components.description: Pane 2 well with an inset chalk ring on focus.
components.css: .ds-q { display:grid; gap:8px; padding:14px; background:#101114; color:#F4F1EB; } .ds-ql { font:700 15px/1.3 'Atkinson Hyperlegible', Verdana, sans-serif; } .ds-field { min-height:48px; padding:10px 14px; border:0; border-radius:12px; background:#24262C; color:#F4F1EB; font:400 17px/1.3 'Atkinson Hyperlegible', Verdana, sans-serif; box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 2px transparent; transition:box-shadow .15s; } .ds-field::placeholder { color:#BDB8B0; } .ds-field:hover { box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 2px #FFFFFF22; } .ds-field:focus, .ds-field:focus-visible { outline:none; box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 2px #F4F1EB; }

components.name: Tile
components.description: Grid square on the thing's darkened colour, name bottom-left.
components.css: .ds-grid { display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr); gap:8px; padding:14px; background:#101114; width:340px; } .ds-tile { position:relative; aspect-ratio:1; border:0; padding:0; border-radius:14px; overflow:hidden; background:var(--c); color:#F4F1EB; text-align:left; transition:transform .25s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-tile:active { transform:scale(.96); } .ds-tile:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #F4F1EB; outline-offset:2px; } .ds-tile-name { position:absolute; left:0; right:0; bottom:0; padding:16px 8px 7px; font:700 14px/1.2 'Atkinson Hyperlegible', Verdana, sans-serif; background:linear-gradient(180deg,#0000,#0008 60%); }

components.name: Segmented Control
components.description: Two-to-three-way switch; chosen option fills chalk.
components.css: .ds-seg { display:flex; gap:4px; padding:4px; border-radius:14px; background:#24262C; width:320px; } .ds-seg button { flex:1; min-height:44px; border:0; border-radius:11px; background:transparent; color:#F4F1EB; font:400 15px/1 'Atkinson Hyperlegible', Verdana, sans-serif; white-space:nowrap; transition:background .2s, color .2s; } .ds-seg button:hover { background:#FFFFFF10; } .ds-seg button:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #F4F1EB; outline-offset:2px; } .ds-seg button.ds-on { background:#F4F1EB; color:#16130F; font-weight:700; }

components.name: Tab Bar
components.description: Home, Everything, chalk plus, Places, Wishes.
components.css: .ds-nav { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:2px; height:68px; padding:0 6px; width:360px; background:#101114; border-top:1px solid #2C2E35; } .ds-tab { flex:1 1 auto; min-height:48px; border:0; background:none; color:#BDB8B0; font:400 15px/1 'Atkinson Hyperlegible', Verdana, sans-serif; white-space:nowrap; } .ds-tab:hover { color:#F4F1EB; } .ds-tab:focus-visible, .ds-plus:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #F4F1EB; outline-offset:2px; border-radius:8px; } .ds-tab.ds-on { color:#F4F1EB; font-weight:700; } .ds-plus { flex:0 0 60px; min-height:56px; border:0; background:none; display:grid; place-items:center; padding:0; } .ds-plus span { width:48px; height:48px; border-radius:14px; background:#F4F1EB; color:#16130F; display:grid; place-items:center; transition:transform .2s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-plus:active span { transform:scale(.92); }

components.name: Stamp
components.description: "Logged" / "Gone": a rotated display word that lands once.
components.css: .ds-stage { padding:24px; background:#101114; color:#7BD3A0; } .ds-stamp { display:inline-block; border:2px solid currentColor; border-radius:8px; padding:5px 12px; font-family: 'Bricolage Grotesque Variable', 'Bricolage Grotesque', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif; font-weight:800; font-size:18px; line-height:1; letter-spacing:.06em; text-transform:uppercase; transform:rotate(-5deg); animation:ds-stamp .42s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1) both; } .ds-stamp:hover { transform:rotate(-5deg) scale(1.03); } @keyframes ds-stamp { from { transform:rotate(-5deg) scale(1.8); opacity:0; } to { transform:rotate(-5deg); opacity:1; } }

components.name: Outfit Bands
components.description: Vertical bands of an outfit's piece colours, growing from the floor.
components.css: .ds-bands { display:flex; width:120px; height:200px; border-radius:16px; overflow:hidden; } .ds-bands > span { flex:1; background:var(--c); transform-origin:bottom; animation:ds-grow .6s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1) both; animation-delay:var(--d); } .ds-bands:hover { outline:3px solid #F4F1EB; outline-offset:-3px; } @keyframes ds-grow { from { transform:scaleY(0); } }

narrative.overview:
A quiet graphite room where the owner's things supply all the colour. Lists sit on near-black; opening a thing floods the whole screen with that thing's colour from the point of the tap, and its page rises in on it. Colour always means something: it is a thing's own shade, its kind, or (for sizes only) how it fits. Nothing is coloured for decoration.

The type is big and confident: Bricolage Grotesque at weight 800 for names, titles and numbers, Atkinson Hyperlegible for everything you read. The layout is a phone in one hand: three-across tiles, rows at least 56px tall, buttons at least 48px, and a fixed tab bar with a chalk plus in the middle. Motion is wanted and every motion has a cause: it shows what just happened, then stops.

It refuses themed worlds (shop windows, rails, dressing rooms, laundry tags), clothes-only metaphors, and the flat grey catalogue with one blue accent.
keyCharacteristics: Graphite ground, chalk text, chalk as the one primary button.
A thing's colour fills whole pages, clamped so chalk text always reads.
Six kind colours for dots, icon wells, chips, empty tiles and bars.
Display 800 for names and numbers; nothing under 14px.
Each motion plays once, on its event.

rules.name: The Own Colour Rule
rules.body: Every colour on screen belongs to a thing, a kind, or a fit. If you cannot say whose colour it is, it is chalk or graphite.

rules.name: The Clamp Rule
rules.body: A thing's colour never fills a surface raw. It goes through the page clamp (or the tile darken) first, so chalk text reads at 4.5:1 on every shade the owner can have.

rules.name: The Fit-Only Rule
rules.body: Green, amber and blue-grey mean fits, tight and loose. They do not decorate, and they do not stand in for success or warning elsewhere, except amber for "needs tailoring", "None yet" and field errors.

rules.name: The 14px Floor Rule
rules.body: No text renders under 14px, on any screen width. On screens 350px wide or less, button labels drop from 16 to 15px and tab labels from 15 to 14px before anything wraps.

rules.name: The Sentence-Case Rule
rules.body: Labels are sentence case at 700. Spaced capitals are kept only for small section captions, and a caption is the section's own heading, never a tag above another heading.

rules.name: The Tonal Step Rule
rules.body: A surface is raised by moving one step lighter (graphite to pane to pane 2) or, on an item colour, by sinking into a well. Do not add a shadow to a card.

dos: **Do** take every coloured surface from a thing (through `itemColour` / `tileColour` / `tintOf`), a kind (`groupColour`), or a fit token.
**Do** keep chalk as the only primary button, and show one per view.
**Do** keep text at 14px or larger and touch targets at 44px or larger; buttons at 48px.
**Do** put fields and fact tiles in wells (`#00000038`) on a coloured page and on pane 2 on graphite.
**Do** give each motion a cause, play it once, and animate only transform, opacity and clip-path.
**Do** use Display 800 with tight tracking for names and numbers, tabular figures for counts.
**Do** keep two or three buttons in a row equal width, shrinking labels to the floor before anything wraps.
donts: **Don't** add decorative colour, gradients or a second accent; colour that belongs to nothing is noise.
**Don't** put a raw, unclamped shade behind text.
**Don't** use green, amber or blue-grey for anything but fit (amber also for tailoring, "None yet" and errors).
**Don't** use thin weights, handwriting faces, or text under 14px.
**Don't** add shadows to cards; raise by a tonal step or a well.
**Don't** add themed worlds or clothes-only metaphors (rails, tags, shop windows).
**Don't** loop a motion for show; only a live process (reading a receipt) may repeat.
